title: South Korea Prepares Pressure Campaign to Force North Korea Apology Over DMZ Landmine Blast
detail: Seoul announced it is preparing a coordinated diplomatic and military response designed to compel Pyongyang to issue a formal apology for a DMZ landmine explosion that wounded South Korean soldiers. The move signals an escalation in inter-Korean tensions following the September 21 blast. South Korea has not disclosed specific measures but indicated they would be consequential.

media.caption: South Korea prepares response over DMZ landmine blast
